# Daniil Zimerman

> Daniil Zimerman (Даниил Цимерман) is a machine learning engineer, vibe-coder,
> and teacher. This is his personal site, hosting his CV, talks, and articles.

## About

- Name: Daniil Zimerman (also transliterated Tsimerman / Zimmerman; Russian: Даниил Цимерман)
- Role: Machine Learning Engineer
- Focus: machine learning, NLP, few-shot learning
- Handle: solemn_leader
